label: Average memory access time
subgoals: Multiply the miss rate by the miss penalty
Nest the formula for each lower cache level

label: Tracing a direct-mapped cache
subgoals: Divide each address by the block size for its block
Reduce the block number modulo the set count for its set
Hit only when the set already holds that block

label: Associativity and LRU
subgoals: Map each block to its set in the associative cache
Keep the most recently used blocks of each set
Evict the least recently used block on a miss
